sections.hook: What happens when you definition $\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = |\mathbf{a}||\mathbf{b}|\cos\theta$? Let's explore scalar (dot) product in IGCSE Add Maths.
sections.core_explanation:
Scalar (Dot) Product

Definition $\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = |\mathbf{a}||\mathbf{b}|\cos\theta$ Component form $a_1b_1 + a_2b_2$ Properties & algebraic rules Perpendicular condition $\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = 0$ Parallel condition $\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = \pm|\mathbf{a}||\mathbf{b}|$ Work done as dot product
sections.worked_example: Worked example for Scalar (Dot) Product will demonstrate key concepts step-by-step.
sections.summary: Scalar (Dot) Product is fundamental for IGCSE Additional Mathematics 0606 C6.
